title: Korean-Style Rice Wrap
description: A quick and easy recipe for a delicious Korean-inspired rice wrap. The velvety sauce adds a rich and creamy element to this meal.
instructions: Prepare the velvety sauce by mixing it with 1 tablespoon of soy sauce and 1 tablespoon of rice vinegar.
Cook the white rice according to package instructions.
Assemble the wrap by spreading a tablespoon of velvety sauce on the wrap, followed by a scoop of cooked rice, 1-2 tablespoons of kimchi, and a few slices of green onions.
Sprinkle crushed toasted sesame seeds on top.
Repeat the layers two more times to make a total of 3 layers.
Cut the wrap in half and serve immediately.
